hooks.name: repo-guards (writes)
hooks.description: Extra to Part E, enforcing Part A.4 and Part H: block gitignoring /.kiro, block skipped tests, ask before adding a dependency that is not on .kiro/approved-dependencies.json.

hooks.name: repo-guards (shell)
hooks.description: Block removing or ignoring /.kiro; ask before deleting tests, installing unapproved packages, running unapproved npx tools, or creating Cloudflare resources.

hooks.name: repo-guards (deletes)
hooks.description: Ask before deleting a test file or anything under /.kiro.
